case_study_spatial_frame.rule: Restrict case-study analytic shapefiles and mapped outputs to City of Chicago geographies while preserving six-county source provenance.

portfolio_rules.fixed_scoring_rule: Hypertension and diabetes each pass and score ≥70; joint area-year usability ≥85%; predictor-only VIF <5
portfolio_rules.required_evidence: Component scores and predictor-only collinearity audit

portfolio_rules.fixed_scoring_rule: Promote passing cardiometabolic bundle; second nonduplicative candidate score ≥70. Tie-break: phenotype score, community usability, comparator alignment, portfolio distinctiveness, written adjudication

scoring_domains.hard_gate: ≥90% of 231 area-years usable and no year <85%

scoring_domains.fixed_scoring_rule: 15 ≥90%; 12 for 80%-89.9%; 8 for 70%-79.9%; 4 for 60%-69.9%; hard fail <60% unless community-area-only predeclared
10 if median area rank correlation ≥0.80 and no discontinuity; 7 for 0.60-0.79; 3 below 0.60; 0 with unexplained discontinuity
scoring_domains.required_evidence: Predictor-only annual ranks and denominator diagnostics

scoring_domains.fixed_scoring_rule: 15 validated stable definition/exclusions; 10 stable diagnosis-only with documented sensitivity; 5 material coding ambiguity; hard fail unresolved
15 aligned crude adult comparator at tract and community-area levels; 10 one level; 5 materially different but interpretable; 0 none
scoring_domains.hard_gate: Independent comparator or aligned supportive mortality construct

scoring_domains.fixed_scoring_rule: 15 direct rationale plus search-bounded gap; 10 supportive rationale/gap; 5 crowded literature with limited distinct contribution; 0 no rationale
scoring_domains.required_evidence: Frozen evidence matrix independent of outcomes

scoring_domains.fixed_scoring_rule: 10 concrete FQHC/CBO questions supported by semantics; 5 general public-health relevance; 0 only speculative action claims
scoring_domains.hard_gate: No unsupported intervention or outcome claim

scoring_domains.fixed_scoring_rule: 5 different phenotype/ascertainment/reliability lesson; 2 partial overlap; 0 duplication
